title: Lighthouse Loft | Pet Friendly WaterColor Condo | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Experience Lighthouse Loft, a pet friendly condo on 30A in WaterColor. Perfect for a relaxing and comfortable stay.
description_expanded: Lighthouse Loft Chic WaterColor Condo Overlooking Cerulean Park Home Introduction Unwind in style at Lighthouse Loft , a beautifully designed 2 bedroom, 2 bath condo in the heart of WaterColor . Overlooking Cerulean Park and just steps from the Beach Club , this one level retreat offers elevated comfort, stylish interiors, and unbeatable walkability to dining, shopping, and coastal experiences. Home Highlights • Pet Friendly - Up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less, non aggressive breeds only (approval and fee required) • Prime Location - Overlooks Cerulean Park with expansive green space • Beach Access - Approximately 100 yards to WaterColor Beach Club • 2 Taxi Bikes - Professionally serviced and ready to ride • One Level Living - No stairs inside the condo, elevator and exterior stair access to third floor unit unavailable • Parking for 1 Vehicle - First come, first serve in building lot • Sleeping for 4 Guests - King suite plus queen guest room • Outdoor Living - Screened porch, covered patio, and private balconies • Fully Equipped Kitchen - Ideal for meal prep and grocery delivery • Dining for 6 - Plus additional outdoor dining area • Smart TV and Cable - In main living area • Laundry Closet - Washer and dryer included • WiFi Included • No Golf Cart Use - LSV rentals restricted due to no charging stations • Community Access - WaterColor Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, and pools (4 guest passes included) Location Perks • 1 minute walk to Cerulean Park • 3 minute bike ride to Central Seaside • Steps to shopping and dining including Wine World, Scratch Biscuit Kitchen, and Beach Happy Cafe • Quick access to WaterColor Beach Club with beach service available Home Details This professionally decorated condo blends comfort and sophistication with an open layout and abundant natural light. The living space flows seamlessly to multiple outdoor areas, including a screened porch and covered balcony overlooking Cerulean Park. The king suite offers a peaceful retreat with its own private balcony and spa like ensuite bath. The guest room is thoughtfully designed with a custom platform bed and direct porch access, creating a cozy and functional second sleeping space. Whether relaxing indoors or enjoying the surrounding green space and nearby beach, Lighthouse Loft offers a refined and convenient WaterColor experience. Know Before You Go • Mid stay clean required for reservations of 10 days or longer (included in rate) • Additional cleaning services available for an extra fee • Wristbands limited to 4 guests age 5 and up per HOA guidelines • Beach towels available at WaterColor Beach Club and Camp WaterColor, and community pools seasonally heated (subject to change) • Concierge services available including grocery delivery, baby equipment rentals, and more • Unauthorized pets may result in fines or eviction ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
